title: IdentitySuspendedEvent
description: Emitted when a canonical identity is suspended (ADR-0016 §8 -- temporary, reversible restriction: security investigation, suspected compromise, temporary workforce suspension, compliance hold). Reversal is the separate identity.reactivated event, not a status this schema itself models. This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
